baselineCellOracle.method: render AgentInlineNote directly with OpenTUI testRender and inspect the cell buffer
baselineCellOracle.draftPaint: Draft text uses #e6edf3 on the panel; trailing padding retains backend-default foreground on the panel.

stableCellOracle.method: repeat the direct OpenTUI cell capture against v0.20.1
stableCellOracle.draftDifference: The stable draft has an extra blank bordered row before the action footer. The newer baseline compact footer is the primary behavior target.

nativeAdaptation.state: React signals and effects become AgentInlineNoteViewState plus explicit synchronize, enter, leave, blur, and action-hover transitions.
nativeAdaptation.editor: OpenTUI textarea ownership becomes shell-owned draft text/focus facts and declarative Ctrl-J, Ctrl-S, and Escape commands.
nativeAdaptation.mouse: JS event handlers become exact row and column action hit records consumed by the Ratatui input router.
nativeAdaptation.layout: OpenTUI boxes and absolute action overlays become immutable cell runs with measured width, thread gutter, frame, wrapping, and bottom-border geometry.
nativeAdaptation.markup: The native STML parser supplies styled runs; empty markup preserves the original plain summary and rationale fallback.
nativeAdaptation.time: Date parsing and relative-age buckets use chrono while retaining the original now, minute, hour, day, week, and year labels.
